policy.excludedContent: No commercial mock question, solution, note, question text, image, media or provider-hosted PDF is copied.
policy.crossCoursePractice: A historic official question may appear in an outgoing and a replacement-course shelf only when the factual reference associates it with both.
policy.completion: A heading is matched only to one unambiguous answer-anchored local SEC card identity.
